findings.description: F-003: the render.py code block did `self.food_turtle.goto(*self.state.food)` with no None guard, although 19.18 states «отрисовка … обязана явно проверить это». Verified to raise TypeError on the WON state, so a reader typing in the excerpt got a crash in the one state the chapter spends a whole section building up to.
findings.resolution: Added the showturtle/goto vs hideturtle guard to the excerpt in build_29, matching snake.py:360-364, plus a warning callout quoting the exact TypeError. Retargeted 19.18's forward reference from «раздел 19.32» to «раздел 19.29», where render() actually lives.

findings.description: F-005: «Раздел 18.35 главы 18 уже вводил идею пула сегментов для рисовалки» was wrong twice — 18.35 does not exist (chapter 18 ends at 18-32) and chapter 18 never mentions pooling at all, so the reader was sent looking for prerequisite material that was never taught.
findings.resolution: Removed the back-reference and replaced it with a self-contained motivation in build_29: the naive per-apple turtle from 19.6, why those objects accumulate across restarts, and the pool as the answer. No chapter-18 dependency remains; chapter 18's own files were not touched.
